title: Reward density: does a dense gold-anchored reward lift the large-H endpoint?
question: REINFORCE at H=256 sees 5 successes in 500 steps. Is the binding constraint the reward's sparsity, or is it the update rule that consumes it?
hypothesis: H_sparse: the binary terminal reward 1[a_t = gold] is the constraint — a denser signal of the same logical kind, with the gold anchor held fixed, lifts routing@1 at H=256. H_credit is the alternative: the policy-gradient update over one scalar is the wrong learning rule at this population, and no reward shaping within this class fixes it.

arms.name: baseline
arms.acts_on: the reproduction reference; the reward stays float(outcome.success)

arms.name: analytic_margin
arms.intervention: the analytic margin s_gold - max_{j!=gold} s_j, centred by a running mean of itself
arms.acts_on: the scalar passed as reward to router.update

arms.name: analytic_margin_clipped
arms.intervention: the analytic margin as above, clipped to [0, 1]
arms.acts_on: the scalar passed as reward to router.update

endpoints.name: routing@1
endpoints.role: the primary endpoint: argmax accuracy at evaluation, from raw dot products
endpoints.description: MATCHED-001's convention raw[gold] == max(raw), ties included. Computed with learn=False and no reward hook on the evaluation router, so the surrogate cannot reach the endpoint it is reported against.

endpoints.name: recall@16
endpoints.role: the paired secondary endpoint: the retrieval budget from F0
endpoints.description: Well-defined only where 16 < H. A material movement here with a flat routing@1 is the weak outcome the decision rule describes.

endpoints.name: delta_1
endpoints.role: secondary — the raw top-1 margin s_gold - s_best_distractor

endpoints.name: gold_rank
endpoints.role: secondary — mean rank of gold; detects whether the field moved past the single best distractor

endpoints.name: accuracy
endpoints.role: secondary — the system consequence, from the executed loop

endpoints.name: entropy
endpoints.role: audit — nats; ln(H) is the uniform-scorer reference

endpoints.name: c_router
endpoints.role: audit — candidates scored, constant by construction in this experiment

decision_rule.condition: delta(routing@1) > spread, where spread is the baseline arm's own max-minus-min across seeds
decision_rule.licenses: H_sparse is supported and H_credit is refuted. The failure was the sparsity of the signal, not the rule that consumes it. Record the mechanism, then re-queue the retrieval index (M2.1, historically Stage F1) on a router whose quality is a property of the scorer rather than of the optimiser.
decision_rule.does_not_license: that the router learned relevance. The surrogate is gold-anchored exactly as the outcome reward is.

decision_rule.licenses: H_credit is supported and H_sparse is refuted, as far as one reward class can refute it. REINFORCE with a linear basis is the wrong learning rule at this population, and this is evidence for a different rule or a different architecture rather than a bare negative. The top-K endpoints are then the secondary reading.
decision_rule.does_not_license: that persistent-state relevance routing does not scale. The hypothesis class provably contains a perfect H-invariant solution (routing@1 = 1.0000 at H in {8,64,256,512} for the analytic vector), so a failure to find the solution with one optimiser is not a statement about the space.

decision_rule.licenses: the intervention is harmful; record and stop. No further arm is added from this design.
decision_rule.does_not_license: any conclusion about the mechanism, because a harmful intervention is a statement about the intervention.

held_constant: the feature basis, the environment, the candidate generator and the evaluator are unchanged in every arm
the intervention is training-only: no arm changes how the router selects at evaluation (epsilon=0, temperature=0.5 always)
the surrogate is computed outside the router from inputs the router already holds; the router's API gains nothing and the gold index appears only to anchor the margin
the centring is a running mean of the surrogate itself, not the per-step mean of the candidate scores, which is negative under the analytic vector
no arm continues from another arm's weights and no arm carries another arm's running-mean baseline
the model-state integrity gate runs before every measurement
the reproduction gate compares the baseline arm against the published MATCHED-001 diagonal before any arm is reported
status: run — the primary endpoint did not fire; the paired secondary endpoint did
result_note: delta(routing@1) = +0.0400 (analytic_margin) and +0.0240 (analytic_margin_clipped) against a 0.0600 materiality threshold: within seed noise. delta(recall@16) = +0.0860 and +0.2460 at H=256, both material; gold_rank 74.70 -> 25.83; the reward's non-zero rate 0.0048 -> 0.9980. The reproduction gate passed, all nine cells diff = 0.0000. The asymmetry is the finding: the learning signal matters for retrieval quality, but exact top-1 ranking at large H remains unresolved. Recorded as claim C11 (L3, bounded at K >= 2).
